rationales.F01: Dyspnea on exertion is a common symptom of prosthetic valve thrombosis and infective endocarditis.
rationales.F02: Orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea are indicative of heart failure, which can be caused by prosthetic valve thrombosis and infective endocarditis.
rationales.F03: Fever is a non-specific symptom that can be associated with infective endocarditis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and antiphospholipid syndrome.
rationales.F05: The absence of photosensitivity, rashes, myalgia, malaise, or lymphadenopathy makes systemic lupus erythematosus less likely.
rationales.F08: Anemia is a common finding in iron deficiency anemia and anemia of chronic disease.
rationales.F10: Prolonged prothrombin time and elevated INR are indicative of coagulopathy, which can be caused by disseminated intravascular coagulation and antiphospholipid syndrome.
